subject: general
question: Kolleru lake is located in the state of_________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Kolleru Lake is one of the largest freshwater lakes in India located in the state of **Andhra Pradesh 15 kilometres** away from the city of Eluru.
 
• Kolleru is located between **Krishna and Godavari deltas.**</li&
